title: Tafs R  Exegesis Of Selected Passages Of The Qur         N On Current Issues
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the dishonorable women, who do not refrain from illicit sexual relations."
The fornicators refer to the dishonorable women, who do not refrain from illicit sexual relations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an injunction of Allah to the people of the Scripture before Islam and to the Muslims."
Piety is an injunction of Allah to the people of the Scripture before Islam and to the Muslims.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the clearest wisdom, unequivocal proof and to Him is the most glorious authority."
Indeed Allah's is the clearest wisdom, unequivocal proof and to Him is the most glorious authority.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a type of people who on the surface appear to be like the type we just mentioned."
The Verse ninety refers to a type of people who on the surface appear to be like the type we just mentioned.
fib: ______ is a marriage that ends upon a pre- determined date.
A mut'ah marriage is a marriage that ends upon a pre- determined date.
______ is the Truth, and whose words can be truer than those of Allah? (Of course, none). 123.
Allah's Promise is the Truth, and whose words can be truer than those of Allah? (Of course, none). 123.
______ refers to not having intercourse with her, to lie on bed with his back to her.
The abandonment refers to not having intercourse with her, to lie on bed with his back to her.
______ is the unit set by Allah and whosoever obeys Allah and his Messenger will be admitted to garden under which rivers flow (in paradise).
Inheritance in Islam is the unit set by Allah and whosoever obeys Allah and his Messenger will be admitted to garden under which rivers flow (in paradise).
